# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This book collects the worked R examples for **EDUS 663: Applied Multivariate Statistics in Education** at Virginia Commonwealth University. Each chapter follows one course module and walks through a complete analysis: loading and preparing data, fitting the model, checking it, and interpreting the results.

The chapters are designed to be read alongside the module readings (mostly from Hancock, Stapleton, & Mueller's *The Reviewer's Guide to Quantitative Methods in the Social Sciences*) and the lecture videos.

## How to use this book

- Every dataset used in the book is in the `data/` folder of the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mikediam123/mvs-textbook). Download the folder and keep it next to your R project so the code runs as written.
- Code is written in tidyverse style. Copy any chunk with the button in its top-right corner.
- Most methods in this course extend regression and ANOVA. If a chapter feels like a big jump, revisit @sec-review first.

## Packages

The packages used across the book can be installed in one step:

```{r}
#| eval: false
install.packages(c(
  "tidyverse", "haven", "psych", "effectsize", "modelsummary",
  "rstatix", "ggpubr", "ggeffects", "lmtest", "broom", "car",
  "performance", "mice", "naniar", "corrplot", "factoextra",
  "GPArotation", "lavaan", "semPlot"
))
```
